scenes.name: Train Whistle & Departure Chime
scenes.subtitle: Platform noise fading • Watching the city slip away from the window

scenes.name: Window Seat & Drifting Rain
scenes.subtitle: Rain streaks on glass • Unfinished memories on the platform

lines.text: Window seat pe baith ke maine, shehar ko chhoot-te dekha hai,
Kanch pe behti boondon jaisa, waqt ko fisalte dekha hai.

scenes.name: One Earphone & Retracing Paths
scenes.subtitle: Humming a forgotten tune • Tracks rushing forward, heart pulling back

lines.text: Ek earphone kaan mein dale, gungunata hoon puraana gaana,
Raste saare aage bhaagein, par dil ko peechhe jaana hai.

scenes.name: Left Behind Station & City Fade
scenes.subtitle: Where you once smiled • That station has slipped away into the dusk

lines.text: Haan chhoot gaya woh station peeche, jahan kabhi tu mila tha mujhe,
Window seat pe baith ke maine, shehar ko chhoot-te dekha hai.

scenes.name: Railway Tracks & Acoustic Journey
scenes.subtitle: Rhythmic steel clatter • Telegraph lines rising and falling against the dusk

scenes.name: Telegraph Wires & Platform Chai
scenes.subtitle: Steam from clay cups • Sunset fading along copper wires

lines.text: Khambhe taaron ke silsile mein, dhoop dhalte dekhi hai,
Chai-wale ki aawazon mein, shaam dhalte dekhi hai.

scenes.name: Crowded Platforms & Unspoken Words
scenes.subtitle: Looking for one face in the crowd • Words that remained in the throat

lines.text: Platform ki bheed mein maine, tera chehra dhoondha tha,
Jo lafz gale mein atke the, unhein chupke se kehna tha.

scenes.name: The Goodbye Wave & Hidden Tears
scenes.subtitle: Smiling while turning away • Hidden tears drenching the whole city

lines.text: Haath hilaya tha tu ne jab, main hans ke mud gaya tha magar,
Aansuon ne chashme ke peechhe, poora shehar bhigoya tha!

scenes.name: Returning to the Window Glass
scenes.subtitle: Rain drops on the glass • A lifetime passing in a moment

lines.text: Window seat pe baith ke maine, shehar ko chhoot-te dekha hai,
Kanch pe behti boondon jaisa, waqt ko fisalte dekha hai.

scenes.name: Roads Running Forward, Heart Looking Back
scenes.subtitle: Speeding rails • Anchored memory

lines.text: Raste saare aage bhaagein, par dil ko peechhe jaana hai,
Window seat pe baith ke maine, shehar ko chhoot-te dekha hai.

scenes.name: Midnight Tunnel & Nightfall
scenes.subtitle: Dark tunnel reflections • Rhythm of the sleeper coach wheels

scenes.name: Dark Tunnel Reflection & Unfinished Stories
scenes.subtitle: When the tunnel comes, own face appears on the glass • Every passenger's quiet tale

lines.text: Tunnel aati hai toh kanch pe, apna hi aks dikhta hai,
Har musafir ki aankhon mein, ek adhura qissa dikhta hai.

scenes.name: Folded Ticket in Pocket
scenes.subtitle: Someone's destination nears, someone just left home • Name scribbled on the ticket

lines.text: Kisi ki manzil aane ko hai, kisi ka ghar chhoota hai abhi,
Meri jeb mein rakhi ticket pe, tera hi naam likha hai abhi!

scenes.name: Ticket Checker & Accompanying Silence
scenes.subtitle: How to tell the conductor • Right beside me, your silence still travels along

lines.text: Ticket checker ko kya samjhayein, yeh seat toh khali lagti hai,
Par mere barabar mein ab bhi, teri khamoshi chalti hai.

scenes.name: Approaching Station & Washing Dust
scenes.subtitle: The air grows cool • The dust of the journey washes from the eyelids

lines.text: Agla station aane wala hai, hawa thandi ho chali hai,
Uss safar ki dhool ab dheere dheere, palkon se dhul chali hai.

scenes.name: Wishing Well & Train Moving Ahead
scenes.subtitle: Wherever you are, stay blessed • The story turns its page into the night

lines.text: Tu jahan bhi ho khush rehna, yeh train aage badh rahi hai,
Peechhe chhoote har lamhe ki, dastaan aage padh rahi hai...

scenes.name: Haan Safar Aage Badh Raha Hai
scenes.subtitle: Forward into the horizon • The train rushes toward dawn

lines.text: Haan safar aage badh raha hai!

scenes.name: Window Breeze & Final Memory
scenes.subtitle: Sitting by the window • The cool wind whispers your name into the quiet dark

lines.text: Window seat pe baith ke, shehar ko chhoot-te dekha hai...
Khidki se aati hawa ne, tera naam pukara hai...
